dataset.description: "Agriculture and Digital Transition: social processes and adaptation strategies of farmers in Alentejo". It outlines the types of data collected, methods for storage, documentation, sharing, and preservation.
dataset.title: FCT - Template in English
dataset.type: The project will generate the following types of data:  Farmer questionnaires – quantitative responses (databases, spreadsheets) and qualitative short-text entries related to digital literacy, agricultural practices, and perceptions of digital technologies.  Semi-structured interviews with farmers – audio files (WAV/MP3) and verbatim textual transcripts pseudonymised to protect participant identities.  Interviews with key stakeholders (associations, technicians) – audio files and textual transcripts, also pseudonymised.  Derived data and analysis scripts – cleaned datasets, tables, figures, and statistical scripts (R/Stata) used for quantitative and qualitative analyses.  These datasets combine numeric, textual, and audio formats, enabling mixed-methods analysis that captures both qualitative perceptions and quantitative patterns.

dmp.description: A tese investiga a relação entre literacia digital dos agricultores no Alentejo e as estratégias de adaptação ou resistência face às tecnologias de agricultura digital. Metodologia: inquéritos por questionário a explorações agrícolas e entrevistas semiestruturadas a intervenientes-chave. Objetivo: mapear perfis digitais, identificar obstáculos e propor recomendações localmente adaptadas.
